title: Select compatible invoice edits with an exhaustive optimum certificate
body:
The new selector combines independent changes to one complete invoice under declared integer resource capacities. It enumerates every subset of up to 16 edits, rejects double spending of original paid/target inventory, and returns the best complete bill with a rigorous global optimum enclosure. This helps contributors find larger gains across compatible edits.

The included example chooses two gains of 4 over a competing gain of 7. Validation includes 25 independent exhaustive oracles, the full 65,536-subset limit, precision ambiguity, exact ties, resource and inventory failures, and an isolated optimized CLI with source hashes. All 7 tests pass normally and under -O on Python 3.12.

The guide supplies the pruning and interval argument, limits, attribution, and open source-binding questions. The optimum is finite and conditional on the declared independent edits and complete capacities. This does not certify a physical construction or increase κ. Live main/priorities/overlap were refreshed for this contribution; coordination: Discussion #5752.

Base: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. Verified head: `3c84a45ca05ed8982f4c0d6975d00a3b29af0f24`.
